chapter_meta_description: Han Li reluctantly agrees to join Jin Qing on a perilous expedition to an ancient cultivator ruin. A new team of allies and rivals assembles on a mysterious, barren island.
og_title: RMJI Ch.423: The Expedition to the Dead Island
og_description: Han Li's next great adventure begins! He assembles with old friends and new, arrogant allies to crack the seal on an ancient cultivator's ruin.
twitter_description: Han Li sets off on a new quest! A dangerous expedition to a mysterious ancient ruin on a desolate island. New allies and old favors collide.

lore_anchors.definition: A Core Formation wandering cultivator and an old acquaintance of Han Li from Heaven Star City.
A Core Formation wandering cultivator who discovered the ancient ruin and organized the expedition.
A Foundation Establishment female cultivator from Red Moon Island, renowned as a formation expert and daughter of the True Man Shi.
The remains of long-dead cultivators, often sealed behind powerful formations and containing lost techniques, rare materials, or magical treasures.
A spell used to temporarily or permanently transform ordinary stone into usable structures like huts or walls.
